evidence.name: Small Art Studio
evidence.description:
This is a small Art studio where is located in Hong Kong. Hong Kong ’s excellent geographical location and unique cultural background, coupled with the ability to receive first-hand information from all over the world. It allows local art creators to integrate Chinese and Western culture and life experience to create unique local features.

This small art studio is for two British couple, who had have taught western art history and context in Hong Kong University for 20 years. They both like small environment which can make them feel all the art surround their emotion body. The Design idea is basic, which they would like to show their fanatic and passion artwork in that room.
